// diagnostic

E0152

A bare `String`, interpolated pattern, or invalid pattern is used as a typed `Regex` literal

What

A bare `String`, interpolated pattern, or invalid pattern is used as a typed `Regex` literal

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Use a valid typed `Regex` literal without interpolation.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0152: tests/ui/dsl_blocks/regex_typed_head_owns_backslashes_but_rejects_holes.stderr.

Error [jet.InvalidRegexLiteral]: A `Regex` literal cannot contain interpolation
  --> tests/ui/dsl_blocks/regex_typed_head_owns_backslashes_but_rejects_holes.jet:4:27
    |
  4 |     pattern :: Regex{"\d+{name}"}
    |                           ^^^^
 Why: The compiler must know the complete pattern before the program runs
 Fix: Use a fixed `Regex{"..."}` pattern, or build text and call `re.compile(text)`
